episodes.title: Chapter One: October Country
episodes.summary: While Greendale readies for a Halloween eclipse, Sabrina faces a crucial decision and Harvey makes an unexpected declaration.

episodes.title: Chapter Two: The Dark Baptism
episodes.summary: A legendary guest visits Spellman Mortuary, Ambrose explores a grim revelation, and Sabrina stuns the coven with a shocking announcement.

episodes.title: Chapter Three: The Trial of Sabrina Spellman
episodes.summary: As Sabrina confronts a long line of family secrets, Harvey faces turmoil at home -- and shares a secret of his own.

episodes.title: Chapter Four: Witch Academy
episodes.summary: Sabrina takes a weekend trip. Father Blackwood poses a pivotal question. Roz and Susie stage an impromptu -- and unnerving -- sleepover.

episodes.title: Chapter Five: Dreams in a Witch House
episodes.summary: A mysterious demon wreaks havoc on Spellman Mortuary. Sabrina goes rogue and puts her powers to the test.

episodes.title: Chapter Six: An Exorcism in Greendale
episodes.summary: Harvey, Roz and Susie explore a mysterious force of evil. Sabrina digs deeper into Ms. Wardwell's intentions. Hilda pursues a new beginning.

episodes.title: Chapter Seven: Feast of Feasts
episodes.summary: The coven prepares for an annual ritual as Harvey takes part in a Kinkle family tradition. Sabrina grows suspicious of Lady Blackwood.

episodes.title: Chapter Eight: The Burial
episodes.summary: A disaster rattles the Greendale community. Desperate to help, Sabrina attempts a new kind of dark magic -- with the assistance of an unusual ally.

episodes.title: Chapter Nine: The Returned Man
episodes.summary: Sabrina recruits Roz for a crucial mission. Susie reconnects with her past. Lord Blackwood challenges Aunt Zelda's authority.

episodes.title: Chapter Ten: The Witching Hour
episodes.summary: A revolutionary attack divides the witches and mortals of Greendale, and Sabrina braces for a life-changing choice.

episodes.title: Chapter Eleven: A Midwinter's Tale
episodes.summary: On the longest night of the year, families gather around the yule fire to sing pagan carols and tell ghost stories. The holidays also are a time for guests and visitors — both welcome and unwelcome — and you never know who'll drop down the chimney.

episodes.title: Chapter Twelve: The Epiphany
episodes.summary: As Sabrina prepares for a spellbinding showcase, Susie embraces a series of new beginnings, and Ms. Wardwell finds greater purpose at Baxter High.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirteen: The Passion of Sabrina Spellman
episodes.summary: A sinister guest visits Spellman Mortuary. Theo faces a cast of cruel critics, and Roz and Harvey pursue an extra-steamy school assignment.

episodes.title: Chapter Fourteen: Lupercalia
episodes.summary: Love and lust sweep through Greendale as Harvey surprises Roz with a sweet gift, and Sabrina explores a romantic ritual ... and her feelings for Nick.

episodes.title: Chapter Fifteen: Doctor Cerberus's House of Horror
episodes.summary: Sabrina, Theo, Roz and others attempt to navigate the lines between fact, fiction and fate when a mysterious stranger sets up shop in Cerberus Books.

episodes.title: Chapter Sixteen: Blackwood
episodes.summary: Tensions rise as Zelda and Father Blackwood's union draws near. Amid the chaos, Sabrina greets a familiar vision and Ambrose uncovers a dark truth.

episodes.title: Chapter Seventeen: The Missionaries
episodes.summary: As Hilda and Sabrina attempt to save Ambrose, Ms. Wardwell considers a crucial move, and a violent group of witch hunters targets the Church of Night.

episodes.title: Chapter Eighteen: The Miracles of Sabrina Spellman
episodes.summary: On the heels of a most perplexing spectacle, Sabrina dives deeper into her newfound power, and Zelda slips into the role of Lady Blackwood.

episodes.title: Chapter Nineteen: The Mandrake
episodes.summary: An ominous discovery leads to a desperate search for answers -- and a risky spell for Sabrina. Meanwhile, Father Blackwood makes a bold announcement.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty: The Mephisto Waltz
episodes.summary: Light and night cross paths once more as Greendale faces the Dark Lord's prophecy and Prudence challenges Father Blackwood's ruthless plan.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-One: The Hellbound Heart
episodes.summary: Sabrina recruits Roz, Harvey and Theo for an emotional mission. Prudence and Ambrose travel to New Orleans. Ms. Wardwell returns to Baxter High.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Two: Drag Me to Hell
episodes.summary: In Greendale, Sabrina explores a new hobby ... and a disturbing duty. Elsewhere, Prudence and Ambrose continue their search for Father Blackwood.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Three: Heavy Is the Crown
episodes.summary: Sabrina visits a mysterious (and familiar) town. Zelda aims to restore order at the academy. A carnival creates buzz in Greendale. Theo takes a chance.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Four: The Hare Moon
episodes.summary: The coven celebrates a festive tradition -- and crosses paths with unexpected guests. Nick struggles to strike a balance between pleasure and pain.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Five: The Devil Within
episodes.summary: Ambrose treats Nick's affliction while Harvey and Theo tend to Roz. Meanwhile, Sabrina and Caliban continue in their unholy regalia challenge.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Six: All of them Witches
episodes.summary: Zelda attempts to forge a supernatural alliance, Sabrina and the gang work with Caliban, and Hilda's transformation takes a terrifying turn.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Seven: The Judas Kiss
episodes.summary: On the heels of tragedy, the Spellmans receive a grim omen. Blackwood seeks vengeance. Sabrina prepares for her final challenge against Caliban.

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Eight: Sabrina Is Legend
episodes.summary: The lines between past, present and future blur as Sabrina stages an act of heroic restoration. But will her powers prove to be enough?

episodes.title: Chapter Twenty-Nine: The Eldritch Dark
episodes.summary: As an all-consuming darkness trickles into town, Sabrina grapples with feeling like the odd witch out — and makes a risky plan for a whirlwind trip.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty: The Uninvited
episodes.summary: A grim visitor sends Roz and Harvey into a panic. Elsewhere, Sabrina reconnects with an enemy from her past, and Aunt Hilda's wedding day arrives.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty-One: The Weird
episodes.summary: The next terror graces Greendale. Sabrina bonds with a new classmate… and finds herself in a squeamish predicament. Roz uncovers a shocking truth.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty-Two: The Imp of the Perverse
episodes.summary: Panic turns political as Sabrina and Roz run for Baxter High co-presidents. Harvey struggles with Roz's reveal. Blackwood takes control of the terror.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty-Three: Deus Ex Machina
episodes.summary: Sabrina encounters a surprise at school — and faces a pivotal decision. Theo explores the perks and pitfalls of Robin's time in the mortal world.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty-Four: The Returned
episodes.summary: As Sabrina longs for a piece of her past, vengeful visitors return to Greendale. The Fright Club competes in a life-or-death battle of the bands.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty-Five: The Endless
episodes.summary: In an alternate universe, Sabrina Morningstar meets a cast of familiar faces — and investigates the thin line between fact and fiction.

episodes.title: Chapter Thirty-Six: At the Mountains of Madness
episodes.summary: The darkest days of the void arrive as Sabrina struggles with grief and regret. Can she summon the strength to overcome an endless cycle of destruction?
